#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int check(const string& tgt, const string& src) {
    int n = tgt.size();
    if (src.size() != n) return 0;

    char xDig = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (src[i] == 'X') {
            if (xDig == 0) {
                xDig = tgt[i];
            } else {
                if (tgt[i] != xDig) return 0;
            }
        }
    }

    if (tgt[0] == '0') return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (src[i] != '_' && src[i] != 'X' && tgt[i] != src[i]) return 0;
    }

    return 1;
}

int processSuffix(const string& suffix, const string& sOG, int n) {
    string s = sOG;
    char last = suffix[1];
    char secondLast = suffix[0];
    bool shit = (s[n-1] != '_' && s[n-1] != 'X' && s[n-1] != last);
    shit |= (s[n-2] != '_' && s[n-2] != 'X' && s[n-2] != secondLast);
    if (suffix != "00") {
        shit |= (s[n-1] == 'X' && s[n-2] == 'X');
    }

    if (shit) return 0;

    if (s[n-1] == 'X') {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            if (s[i] == 'X')
                s[i] = last;
    } else if (s[n-2] == 'X') {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            if (s[i] == 'X')
                s[i] = secondLast;
    }

    s[n-1] = last;
    s[n-2] = secondLast;

    int count = check(suffix, s);
    for (int num = 0; num < 1000000; ++num) {
        string tgt = to_string(num) + suffix;
        count += check(tgt, s);
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    string sOG;
    cin >> sOG;
    int n = sOG.size();

    if (n == 1) {
        if (sOG[0] == '0' || sOG[0] == '_' || sOG[0] == 'X')
            cout << 1 << endl;
        else
            cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int answer = 0;
    answer += processSuffix("00", sOG, n);
    answer += processSuffix("25", sOG, n);
    answer += processSuffix("50", sOG, n);
    answer += processSuffix("75", sOG, n);

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
